Strong and em tags use underscore symbol instead of asterisk

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"strong_em_symbol\":\"_\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p><strong>bold</strong> and <em>italic</em></p>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
